workarounds.note: the index note is a heading attribute (note="…") that the opener design prints above the two columns, not a paragraph: as the first paragraph under the index heading, column balancing's loose-paragraph lever spread it to twelve characters a line in a column of fourteen to even out the Traditional edition's last page

design text sets every Chinese mark full width and has no line-start or line-end rules (禁则): with ，；、 inside its lines the note set them a full em beside the Kaiming half-width marks of the Simplified text around it, and the Traditional note broke inside 頁碼. It is written as three sentences, one to a line with the \n escape, each ending in 。, its only mark

what.en: Dream of the Red Chamber (紅樓夢), chapters 1–3, passages where the characters first appear, in the Cheng–Gao edition of 1792 (程乙本); Wikisource transcription, revision 9685985. The Traditional edition reads the source's 原系 as 原係; both set its －－ as ——; the Simplified edition converted with OpenCC
what.es: Sueño en el pabellón rojo (紅樓夢), capítulos 1 a 3, pasajes en que aparecen los personajes, en la edición de Cheng y Gao de 1792 (程乙本); transcripción de Wikisource, revisión 9685985. La edición tradicional lee 原係 donde el original dice 原系; las dos componen su －－ como ——; la edición simplificada, convertida con OpenCC

text.who: Cao Xueqin, Cheng Weiyuan and Gao E; transcription by Wikisource editors
